description: A yellow tabletop sits in front of a white fabric backdrop, with a light blue cloth on the surface and a small spray bottle near the right side. The left hand presses the cloth against the table and wipes in short strokes toward the right and down-right, then lifts and repositions it back left before sliding it right again, while the right hand holds the spray bottle nearby, briefly tilting it downward and then returning upright without spraying.
